findingsWithCommentsSAST.title: Command_Injection
userComments:
1. This path is only hittable during local interactive CLI execution. The flagged input() calls are Python terminal prompts in the Phase 3 human review tool (agent/tools/hitl/phase3_gate.py), used only when a developer/reviewer runs the pipeline locally with HITL enabled via CLI/resume.

2. This code is not part of the deployed web/API review flow. In deployed execution, Phase 3 runs with the interactive terminal gate disabled, and reviewer changes are handled through structured API HITL endpoints and JSON correction payloads.

3. The collected values are review choices, taxonomy codes, amounts, or file hints saved into pipeline JSON artifacts. They are not used to build shell commands, OS commands, or subprocess command strings.

4. Because no external request path reaches these terminal prompts and no command execution sink consumes the values, there is no practical command injection path here. This is a scanner heuristic mismatch for CLI-only interactive input.

findingsWithCommentsSCA.title: CVE-2026-45829
findingsWithCommentsSCA.cve_summary: A pre-authentication, code injection vulnerability in version 1.0.0 and later of the ChromaDB Python project allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary code on the server by sending a malicious model repository and `trust_remote_code` set to true in the `/api/v2/tenants/{tenant}/databases/{db}/collections` endpoint.
